messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — new 13B bring-up (q8) in eu-west with FlashAttention v3 looks worse than the Triton vendor kernel for short sequences. posted latency/throughput charts in the drive: https://rwd/infer/charts/13b-q8-eu-west
Mike: ta. saw a blip earlier. suspect packing/continuous-batching differences + kernel launch overhead for seq<=64.
Raj: can you paste p50/p95 numbers?
Anya: p50 flashv3 H100 eu-west = 18ms, Triton vendor = 12ms. p95 flashv3 = 72ms, Triton = 40ms. At target 200 rps sustained throughput, flashv3 drops ~30% compared to triton.
Kai: what batcher config + packing enabled? kv-cache warmup?
Anya: config snippet:
```
model: redwood-13b-q8
batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefer_packing: true
  max_batch_size: 32
runtime:
  kernel: flashv3
  use_kv_cache: true
  driver: nvidia-535.43
```
Jen: fwiw i ran a q8 quant regression sweep on the same model and saw a small quality hit when switching kernels — ~0.8 ROUGE pts on our eval set. probably numerics/ordering differences.
Luis: vendor kernels sometimes reorder matmuls/attn for perf which shifts rounding noise. small but visible on strict evals.
perf-bot: cross-region note: us-east H100 + flashv3 p95 = 45ms, eu-west p95 = 72ms. Hardware/driver mismatch or topology difference suspected.
Mike: hypothesis: kernel selector needs to consider three axes: request shape (seq length distribution), quantization level, and region/hardware driver version. For short, low-latency paths use Triton vendor kernel; for long sequences or heavy batching use FlashV3.
Anya: +1. but add hysteresis to avoid flip-flop during bursts. propose rules: if rolling 10m p95 improves by >15% AND throughput delta <5% then flip, else keep.
Raj: can we automate A/B canary? route 5% traffic to candidate kernel, collect latency + eval-set QoE for 48h, then promote if no regressions. Tie to Redwood Optimize eval hooks.
Kai: ops detail: several eu-west hosts are on nvidia-535.43 which has a regression with flashv3 launch path. We should gate flashv3 by driver >= 536.x or fallback. I'll add startup check.
Jen: i'll assemble a 120-prompt eval suite focusing on short-turn dialogues + code completions to detect q8 regressions.
Anya: action items:
- create canary job in eu-west that routes 5% -> Triton kernel with identical batching (Raj/Mike)
- update kernel-selector to include seq-shape heuristic + driver check (Kai)
- add eval suite (Jen) and hook into canary run (Luis)
- add rollout hysteresis thresholds to selector (Anya)
I'll open the PR and ping reviewers.
Mike: assign me for review, happy to help tune heuristics. :thumbsup:
Anya: thanks — i'll post the PR and the canary dashboard link here once ready.
